newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, blue chips dip.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, blue chips dip.

text.p: Croatian stocks traded mixed in slower trade on Tuesday with food firm Podravka forging ahead.
* Six of 13 active stocks rose, four fell and three ended flat.
* Volume lower at 20,937 units, turnover 7.4 million kuna.
* Podravka was top gainer, rising 57 kuna or 17.92 percent to 375 and the most active issue with 11,303 shares sold.
* Biggest decliner, Zagrebacka Banka's preference E-stock, fell 50 kuna or 5.0 percent to 165 kuna.
* Blue chips drugs firm Pliva and Zagrebacka dipped slightly to close at 500 and 1,850 kuna, respectively.
